decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes, you can still plant garlic in August. According to the manual, while the beginning of the rainy period (June-July) is the favorable time for rain-fed agriculture, if there is a possibility to supplement with irrigation, garlic can be planted in August.
decision.justification: The document explicitly states in section 3.6 (Planting time) on page 11 that 'In rain fed agriculture the beginning of the rainy period (June-July) is the favourable period and if there is possibility to supplement by irrigation it can be planted in August.'
